title: How fast is each one?
prompt: Place each one by the speed Guinness lists for it.

items.label: Cheetah
items.fact: A 35 kg adult female cheetah was recorded at 103.4 km/h over 201.2 metres in 1965.

items.label: Formula Rossa roller coaster
items.fact: Formula Rossa reaches 240 km/h and climbs 52 metres in 4.9 seconds.

items.label: Thrust SSC land-speed car
items.fact: Thrust SSC became the first car to break the sound barrier when it reached Mach 1.020 in 1997.

items.label: X-15A-2 rocket plane
items.fact: The X-15A-2 reached Mach 6.7 at an altitude of 31,120 metres in 1967.

items.label: Apollo 10 command module
items.fact: Apollo 10's crew reached 39,897 km/h on the trans-Earth return flight in May 1969.

items.label: Mercury orbiting the Sun
items.fact: Mercury's average orbital speed is 172,248 km/h, and one orbit takes 87 days 21 hours.
